te: Follow-up on southern border proposals, preparing the Lopburi–Saraburi study visit, and preparing to invite agencies on disasters from global warming
se: The meeting followed up on the proposals on the unrest, drugs and the Thailand–Malaysia border fence, which are to be considered by the working group on peace and development in the southern border provinces, and on remedy and recovery for those affected, for which initial information is to be gathered and presented to the committee. It noted progress on presenting the report on using reserve forces to support disaster relief to the Senate in late November or early December 2026, considered the schedule of the study visit to Lopburi and Saraburi on 25–26 November 2026, assigned the working group on law and special affairs to gather information and look into the initial facts of a proposal from the Senators Meet the People project, southern group (lower south), and agreed to invite agency representatives to give information on preparing to prevent disaster crises caused by global warming, to be put to the committee for approval
it: Proposals on the unrest, drugs and the Thai–Malaysian border fence
Proposal from the Senators Meet the People project, southern group (lower south)
Report on using reserve forces to support disaster relief
Schedule of the study visit to Lopburi and Saraburi, 25–26 Nov 2026
Inviting agencies to give information on preparing to prevent disaster crises caused by global warming
Seminar on the transition to a new-era reserve force development system, 19 Jan 2027

te: Pre-meeting video · Follow-up on southern border proposals, preparing the Lopburi–Saraburi study visit, and preparing to invite agencies on disasters from global warming
Southern border matter referred to the peace-building working group, and the Lop Buri–Saraburi visit shortened to 1 days
se: The meeting referred the proposals on the unrest, drugs and the Thai–Malaysian border fence to the working group on peace-building and development of the southern border provinces, asked for preliminary information to be gathered from the petitioners and agencies on proposals for the recovery and relief of those affected, for submission to the committee, and proposed shortening the study visit to Lop Buri and Saraburi from 2 days to 1 days. It also noted preparations for the seminar on 19 January 2027
it: Proposals on the unrest, drugs and the Thai–Malaysian border fence
Proposals on the recovery and relief of those affected in the southern border provinces
Changes to the study visit to Lop Buri and Saraburi Provinces

te: Meeting summary video · Southern border matter referred to the peace-building working group, and the Lop Buri–Saraburi visit shortened to 1 days
Southern border matter is sensitive and to be considered carefully, and a seminar on a modern reserve force prepared
se: The meeting noted the working group's report on proposals concerning the unrest in the southern border provinces, drugs and the Thai–Malaysian border fence. As this is a sensitive matter, it asked for approaches to be considered carefully. It also considered proposals to push forward legislation, the plan for study visits on 25–26 November 2026, the plan for the seminar "Building a Modern Reserve Force" in January 2027, and the framework of work on peace in the southern border provinces
it: Report on proposals on the unrest, drugs and the Thai–Malaysian border fence
Plan for study visits, 25–26 November 2026
Plan for the seminar on building a modern reserve force, January 2027

te: Meeting summary video · Southern border matter is sensitive and to be considered carefully, and a seminar on a modern reserve force prepared
Working groups report on life insurance for personnel, a seminar on reserve forces, and land for veterans
se: The meeting noted the reports of 4 working groups, such as information on life insurance for personnel of the 2th Army Area, the plan for study visits to Lop Buri and Saraburi in November, the seminar topic "Integrated Personnel Management: From Civilians to the Reserve Force of the Future", a project on career development and land allocation for veterans, and the recommendations of the National Human Rights Commission on amending the law on the constitution of military courts
it: Progress of 4 working groups (armed forces structure, reserve forces, veterans, law and special affairs)
Recommendations of the National Human Rights Commission on amending the Act on the Constitution of Military Courts B.E. 2498 (1955)

te: Meeting summary video · Working groups report on life insurance for personnel, a seminar on reserve forces, and land for veterans
Report on special allowances for personnel considered, and a summary of 2 year(s) of work
se: The meeting considered the working group's draft report on increasing special allowances for personnel serving in border field operations or combat situations, the draft annual report, and a video summarising 2 year(s) of work. It noted the committee's resolution to put on hold a complaint concerning the domestic firearms manufacturing business, and considered approaches to improving the related laws and regulations
it: Draft report on increasing special allowances for personnel
Draft annual report, and video summarising 2 year(s) of work
Complaint concerning the domestic firearms manufacturing business

te: Meeting summary video · Report on special allowances for personnel considered, and a summary of 2 year(s) of work
Framework for work on peace in the southern border provinces set, and the draft annual report
se: The meeting invited experts to give views, considered the framework for work on building peace, public safety and development in the southern border provinces, and considered the draft report on the subcommittee's work in fiscal year 2026
it: Framework for work on building peace and development in the southern border provinces
Draft report on the subcommittee's work (1 October 2025 – 30 September 2026)

te: Proposals from people in the southern border provinces taken up for study, and a study visit to Chulachomklao Royal Military Academy prepared
se: The meeting noted matters referred by the committee from the Senators Meet the People project, lower southern group (Narathiwat, Pattani, Yala), on the unrest, drugs, a proposal to build a Thai–Malaysian border fence, and security laws. It considered the study visit to Nakhon Nayok Province and Chulachomklao Royal Military Academy on 24 September 2026, and asked the working groups to add study visit plans to the 2027 action plan
it: Proposals from the Senators Meet the People project, lower southern group
Study visit to Nakhon Nayok Province and Chulachomklao Royal Military Academy, 24 September 2026
Action plan for fiscal year 2027

te: Draft letter replying on the difficulties of the Marine Ranger Task Force, and allowances followed up
se: The meeting considered the action plan for fiscal year 2027 and the work of the working groups, such as the committee's draft letter replying on the problems and proposals of the Marine Ranger Task Force, and progress on special allowances for personnel serving in border field operations or combat situations, on which a joint meeting with government agencies will be held on 18 September 2026
it: Draft letter replying on the difficulties of the Marine Ranger Task Force
Special allowances for personnel serving in border field operations or combat situations

te: Progress report on the draft military courts law sent to the committee, and a study visit to the Judge Advocate General's Department prepared
se: The meeting approved the progress report on the study of the draft laws on military courts and on the organisation of the Ministry of Defence for submission to the committee, and noted the schedule of a study visit on military justice at the Judge Advocate General's Department on 16 September 2026, the action plan for fiscal year 2027, and the approach to the annual report
it: Progress report on the study of the draft Act on the Constitution of Military Courts (No. ..) B.E. .... and the draft Act on the Organisation of the Ministry of Defence (No. ..) B.E. .... (proposed by the Council of Ministers)

te: Draft report on the study of the draft laws on military courts and on the organisation of the Ministry of Defence approved
se: The meeting approved the draft report on the study of the draft Act on the Constitution of Military Courts (No. ..) B.E. .... and the draft Act on the Organisation of the Ministry of Defence (No. ..) B.E. .... (proposed by the Council of Ministers), with observations and recommendations. It took on additional work on approaches to building peace and developing the southern border provinces, postponed the site visit to Prachuap Khiri Khan to 17–18 September 2026, and considered the action plan for fiscal year 2027

te: Study visits to the Civil Aviation Training Center and NSTDA summarised, and a TV programme on veterans
se: The meeting noted the broadcast of the programme "Mong Ratthasapha" on promoting careers for veterans through an electric taxi project, and the summaries of study visits to the Civil Aviation Training Center on aviation security and to the National Science and Technology Development Agency
